# trace-to-skill

> Turn failed AI coding-agent runs into reusable AGENTS.md rules, SKILL.md files, and eval evidence.

Useful entry points:

- README: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill#readme
- Roadmap: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md
- Failure taxonomy: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/FAILURE_TAXONOMY.md
- OpenAI OSS strategy: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/OPENAI_OSS_STRATEGY.md
- Adoption guide: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION_GUIDE.md
- Benchmark scorecard: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK.md
- Combined scorecard: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/docs/SCORECARD.md
- Codex readiness auditor skill: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/skills/codex-readiness-auditor/SKILL.md
- Analysis JSON schema: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/schemas/analysis-result.schema.json
- AGENTS.md linter JSON schema: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/schemas/agents-lint-result.schema.json
- Doctor JSON schema: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/schemas/doctor-result.schema.json
- Scorecard JSON schema: https://github.com/grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill/blob/main/schemas/scorecard-result.schema.json

Detected failure classes include missing validation, failed tests, hallucinated files, instruction drift, over-editing, unsafe commands, secret exposure, hidden Unicode, prompt injection in untrusted text, MCP risk, and weak completion evidence.

Core commands:

```bash
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill doctor .
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill doctor . --threshold 85
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill doctor . --format comment
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill doctor-comment . --threshold 85 --dry-run
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill lint-agents .
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill init --comment --sarif
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill benchmark
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill scorecard .
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill scorecard-comment . --dry-run
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill guard-github-event "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill analyze ./runs
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill init --comment --sarif
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill analyze ./runs --format sarif --output trace-to-skill.sarif
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill suggest ./runs --target agents-md
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill eval ./runs --threshold 80
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill comment ./runs --dry-run
npx github:grnbtqdbyx-create/trace-to-skill compare --before ./runs/before --after ./runs/after
```
